The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Generate and nurture leads in coordination with vertical and field marketing activities to achieve targeted new revenue growth. Cultivate leads and foster opportunities within assigned geographies using a value-based approach. Manage and expand existing business relationships to ensure targeted and sustainable revenue growth, including exploring additional regions and products. Understand and analyze customers' broader business objectives to build profiles and act as a consultant for their business strategies. Translate customer strategies into meaningful opportunities that add value for Aramex. Present solutions to customers, demonstrating the value proposition for their business and aligning with their goals. Identify and develop effective relationships with key contacts within targeted customer organizations in respective regions to maximize leverage for Aramex. Collaborate with the solutions group to define innovative solutions that add value to customers' business operations. Work closely with account managers to ensure a seamless customer experience throughout the sales process. 01893b49e2c52a32.description: About the Role امبير للمقاولات is seeking a Buildings Operations & Maintenance Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves overseeing the operation and maintenance of contracted buildings, ensuring the effective implementation of preventive and corrective maintenance plans across various systems. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and offers a salary range of SAR 3,750 - SAR 5,625. Role Overview The Buildings Operations & Maintenance Supervisor will be responsible for supervising maintenance teams and managing service requests and emergency breakdowns within agreed response times. The primary objective is to ensure operational continuity in compliance with quality, safety, and budgetary standards, while maintaining asset efficiency and client satisfaction for electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and civil systems. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement periodic preventive maintenance plans for each assigned building, ensuring timely execution. Supervise the maintenance of HVAC systems, electrical installations, plumbing, pumps, water tanks, and generators. Conduct regular building inspections to identify potential faults and report maintenance issues before they escalate. Receive and manage maintenance requests through the ticketing system and assign tasks to appropriate technicians. Monitor service requests to ensure closure within the response and resolution times agreed upon with clients. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in buildings operations and maintenance supervision. Demonstrated ability to oversee preventive and corrective maintenance plans. Experience with electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and civil systems. Required Skills Strong supervisory skills for leading maintenance teams. Proficiency in managing service requests and emergency breakdowns. Ability to ensure compliance with quality, safety, and budgetary standards. Effective communication and client satisfaction management skills. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply for this full-time position in Riyadh.

01ad5082d2bb8e28.description: About the Role Lucid Motors Middle East is seeking a Sr. Technician (Digital LV) to join their team in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to supporting ECU Manufacturing through hands-on technical execution for software-release readiness, ECU flashing, manufacturing testing, and sustaining production. The Senior Technician will independently support pre-release testing, maintain flashing tools and test-station computers, and resolve technical issues affecting engineering builds and production rollout. Role Context and Collaboration The position requires applying advanced practical knowledge of electronics, Windows-based systems, wiring diagrams, harnesses, connectors, diagnostic interfaces, and electrical troubleshooting. The Senior Technician will coordinate with manufacturing test engineers, technical program managers, software engineers, operations teams, and contract manufacturers across multiple programs to ensure smooth operations and timely issue resolution. Key Responsibilities Establish, maintain, and track ECU software releases for engineering builds and production activities. Act as the primary technician supporting users and coordinating software-release activities within the flashing area. Execute the in-house ECU software-release process with Manufacturing Test, Operations, and contract manufacturers. Collaborate with technical program managers, software engineers, and test engineers to implement and maintain release tools, processes, and supporting solutions. Provide software-file locations, flashing tools, traceability information, and related technical support for engineering builds and production. Communicate activities, risks, issues, and status for assigned programs to the responsible Test Engineer. Review, track, and support sign-off of software DEVREQs and ECRs for internal and external ECUs. Coordinate multiple concurrent releases, builds, and deployments from development through production rollout. Execute and track pre-release software testing in the Manufacturing Test laboratory, contract-manufacturer locations, and internal sites. Track open software and test-station issues, perform technical troubleshooting, and drive assigned actions to resolution. Technical Expertise and Support Inspect, troubleshoot, repair, and verify harnesses, connectors, wiring, and pinouts used in ECU flashing and test stations. Diagnose and resolve USB, Ethernet, serial, diagnostic-interface, and flashing-tool communication issues. Maintain test-station computers through Windows troubleshooting, software setup, driver installation, network-connectivity support, and peripheral configuration. Provide practical technical guidance to other technicians and users within the assigned scope when required. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in a technical capacity, demonstrating proficiency in electronics, Windows-based systems, and electrical troubleshooting within a manufacturing or production environment. Application Process Lucid Motors Middle East invites qualified candidates to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

01ea1880eb484d40.description: About the Role Pace | Architecture, Engineering + Planning is seeking an experienced Contract Administrator to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing all aspects of contract administration for a construction project, ensuring adherence to contractual terms and conditions. The Administrator will provide contractual guidance and advice to the client. Key Responsibilities Act as the primary point of contact for all contractual matters between project stakeholders and contractors. Review, interpret, and manage all project contracts, including preparing and actioning contractual letters and correspondences, ensuring compliance with local and international regulations and standards. Manage and track all contractual obligations, milestones, and deliverables. Monitor contract performance to ensure all parties fulfill their obligations. Assess and process changes to the original contract scope, such as modifications, variations, and additional works. Manage cost adjustments related to scope changes, ensuring proper accounting and documentation. Ensure all change orders are clearly documented, agreed upon by all parties, and executed promptly. Collaborate with finance and project teams on payment tracking, invoicing, and contractual cost management. Coordinate with project managers to ensure work progresses according to the established contract schedule. Identify and assess potential contractual risks, advising the project team on mitigation strategies. Track and manage claims, disputes, and delays, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with contract terms. Act as a liaison for resolving conflicts, disputes, or issues related to contractual terms and conditions. Address discrepancies or issues arising from contract performance and work with relevant parties to resolve them. Report to the project director and collaborate with project team members to resolve disputes through negotiation, mediation, or legal proceedings if necessary. Maintain and update a comprehensive record of contract correspondence, change orders, and amendments. Prepare reports on contract status, risks, and disputes for senior management and other stakeholders. Provide regular updates to senior management regarding financial status, risks, and contract performance. Ensure all project contracts comply with local, national, and international regulations and codes. Ensure compliance with the terms of insurance, bonds, warranties, and other legal requirements. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in contract administration, preferably within the construction industry. Demonstrated ability to manage complex contractual discussions and advise clients effectively. Strong understanding of contractual terms, conditions, and legal frameworks relevant to construction projects. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to projects in Jeddah. The role involves working closely with project directors, project teams, and external stakeholders to ensure contractual compliance and project success.

0123d538a0704839.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة حلول النفط للصناعات، العاملة في قطاع صناعة البتروكيماويات، عن حاجتها إلى مستشار قانوني بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. يرتبط المستشار القانوني مباشرة بالإدارة العليا، ويتولى مسؤولية تقديم الاستشارات القانونية الشاملة للشركة، وصياغة العقود ومراجعتها، بالإضافة إلى تمثيل الشركة أمام الجهات القضائية وشبه القضائية والحكومية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الاستشارات القانونية للإدارة العليا وإدارات الشركة المختلفة. صياغة ومراجعة العقود والاتفاقيات، بما في ذلك عقود التوريد، البيع، الشراء، الخدمات، والعمل. تمثيل الشركة بصفة نظامية أمام الجهات القضائية، شبه القضائية، والجهات الحكومية. إعداد المذكرات واللوائح القانونية، ومتابعة القضايا والجلسات عبر منصة ناجز. متابعة المطالبات المالية وتحصيل مستحقات الشركة بالطرق النظامية. معالجة القضايا العمالية بالتنسيق مع إدارة الموارد البشرية. متابعة الاعتراضات والمنازعات الضريبية والزكوية بالتنسيق مع الإدارة المالية. متابعة السجلات التجارية والتراخيص والوكالات وتجديدها. مراجعة السياسات واللوائح الداخلية لضمان توافقها مع الأنظمة المعمول بها. رصد التحديثات النظامية ذات الصلة بنشاط الشركة، وبيان أثرها للإدارة. إدارة العلاقة مع مكاتب المحاماة الخارجية عند الحاجة، والإشراف على أعمالها. حفظ وتنظيم الملفات والمستندات القانونية. إعداد التقارير الدورية عن القضايا والموقف القانوني للشركة ورفعها إلى الإدارة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الاستشارات القانونية، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع صناعي أو شركات مماثلة. معرفة عميقة بالأنظمة واللوائح المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية. القدرة على صياغة العقود والمذكرات القانونية بدقة واحترافية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على حل المشكلات القانونية المعقدة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بالدقة والمواعيد النهائية. بيئة العمل يتطلب هذا الدور العمل بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية، مع الارتباط المباشر بالإدارة العليا للشركة. تلتزم الشركة بضمان التزامها بالأنظمة واللوائح المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية المقابلة.

014a25507c47ed34.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Worker Welfare to lead the Worker Welfare function for City Operations in Riyadh Province. This full-time role focuses on occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics, and the overall quality of the working environment. The Director will establish governance, assurance, and monitoring arrangements to protect worker wellbeing and ensure fair, safe, and healthy working conditions across City Operations and its service-provider activities. Core Responsibilities Lead the City Operations Worker Welfare function and translate corporate requirements into practical standards, plans, and controls. Establish a worker welfare governance, assurance, and monitoring framework covering occupational health, workplace safety, ergonomics, welfare facilities, and working-environment conditions. Develop risk-based inspection and review programs for City Operations workplaces and service-provider operations. Monitor worker welfare performance, trends, concerns, and corrective actions, escalating material issues to leadership. Coordinate with Health & Safety, FLS, Human Capital, Procurement, Operations, Asset Management, and service providers to embed worker welfare requirements into operational delivery. Support the assessment and improvement of workplace ergonomics, job design, welfare facilities, and environmental conditions affecting worker health and wellbeing. Oversee investigation and follow-up of worker welfare concerns, non-compliances, and recurring workplace issues. Ensure worker welfare requirements are incorporated into contractor scopes, mobilization, performance monitoring, and service reviews. Build awareness and capability through guidance, training, and engagement with employees and service providers. Specific Duties Develop and maintain the City Operations Worker Welfare Plan, procedures, checklists, and reporting arrangements. Maintain a worker welfare risk and action register with accountable owners and closure evidence. Coordinate occupational health and ergonomic assessments where required and track recommended improvements. Conduct or coordinate worker interviews, workplace observations, and welfare-facility reviews as part of assurance activities. Produce periodic dashboards and management reports covering leading indicators, findings, trends, and overdue actions. Support continual improvement of working conditions across City Operations. General Responsibilities Contribute to annual business planning, workforce planning, and budget management for the function. Lead, coach, and develop assigned teams and specialist service providers. Promote a culture of accountability, prevention, continual improvement, and evidence-based decision-making. Maintain accurate records and provide timely reports, presentations, and recommendations to City Operations leadership. Perform other related duties consistent with the role and business requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within Qiddiya Investment Company's City Operations. The role involves collaboration with various internal departments and external service providers to ensure comprehensive worker welfare standards.

016f203a89325527.description: About the Role King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM) is seeking a Student Mobility Specialist to manage and enhance student exchange programs. This full-time role involves coordinating all aspects of student mobility, from initial application to program completion, ensuring a smooth and supportive experience for students. Key Responsibilities Coordinate inbound and outbound student mobility processes, including nominations, documentation, approvals, enrolment, and pre-departure activities. Review and improve mobility processes, workflows, and service standards, identifying opportunities for streamlining, digitization, and automation. Provide clear and timely information and support to students throughout their mobility lifecycle, coordinating communications, briefings, and pre-departure activities. Maintain accurate mobility records and data across relevant systems, producing regular reports and performance information for leadership. Work with academic units and professional services to ensure effective delivery of mobility programs and coordinate operational matters with international partners. Ensure mobility activities comply with university policies and relevant requirements, supporting risk management for international student mobility. Monitor mobility performance against agreed KPIs and service standards, implementing improvements to increase efficiency and service quality. Process and Service Improvement The specialist will be responsible for continuous improvement initiatives within student mobility operations. This includes developing and maintaining clear procedures, guidance, and operational documentation to enhance efficiency and scalability of services. Student Experience and Support A core aspect of this role is to enhance the student experience. The specialist will use student feedback and operational insights to improve the overall mobility journey, ensuring students receive comprehensive support and information. Data Management and Reporting This position requires strong capabilities in data management and analysis. The specialist will identify trends, issues, and opportunities through mobility data analysis to inform strategic decisions for Global Engagement leadership. Required Experience Candidates should possess 7-10 years of relevant experience in student mobility, international education, or a related field. The role requires a professional who can effectively coordinate with various stakeholders and ensure compliance with university policies.

018433b776655452.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تقنيه السياره لخدمات السيارات عن ميكانيكي سيارات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص أعطال السيارات وإصلاحها، بالإضافة إلى تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والأجهزة وفقاً لأدلة الصيانة والتعليمات المحددة. كما يتضمن الدور تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة وفعالة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية فحص أداء المعدات الكهربائية والميكانيكية للسيارات ومعايرتها بعد التركيب، مع ضمان التقيد التام بالمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية لقطع الغيار للتأكد من خلوها من الأضرار والتلفيات الخطرة، وتركيب نظم السيارات وتصليحها. التحقيق في الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، وتشخيص المكونات المعيبة وتصليحها أو استبدالها، ومتابعة الأعمال المنجزة لضمان الجودة. تركيب المحركات والمعدات الميكانيكية والكهربائية للسيارات، بالإضافة إلى صيانتها وتصليحها بشكل دوري أو عند الحاجة. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا السيارات. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية بدقة وإصلاحها بفعالية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والأجهزة. الالتزام بتطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتوقع من المرشح أن يكون مقيماً في الرياض أو مستعداً للانتقال إليها. طبيعة العمل يعمل ميكانيكي السيارات ضمن فريق متخصص، ويتحمل مسؤولية مباشرة عن الحفاظ على كفاءة وأداء المركبات. يتطلب الدور مهارات فنية قوية وقدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وضمن فريق لضمان تقديم أفضل الخدمات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

0184b798bfbbbd33.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة برايم إنترناشونال عن معلم للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص المحدد، وتطوير خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي لتعزيز تنمية الطلاب الأكاديمية والشخصية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدريس الطلاب في مجال التخصص المحدد، مع التركيز على تقديم تعليم فعال ومحفز. وضع خطط الدروس التي تتوافق مع موضوع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة. تقديم التعليمات الفردية والجماعية للطلاب، مع مراعاة الاحتياجات التعليمية المتنوعة. اختيار المصادر التعليمية وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس لضمان جودة المحتوى. تطبيق طرق تدريس مبتكرة وفعالة لدعم عملية التعلم وتنمية الطلاب. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التدريس. القدرة على وضع خطط دروس متكاملة وتصميم مواد تعليمية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة والقدرة على التفاعل بفعالية مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المعلم ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق أفضل النتائج الأكاديمية للطلاب. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة برايم إنترناشونال.

019111876abe5536.description: About the Role Daikin Saudi is seeking a Dealer Sales Engineer – DX to be based in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for driving Daikin’s direct expansion (DX) business through the dealer network across the central region. The position focuses on developing, enabling, and managing dealers to maximize sales of split, ducted, and packaged DX solutions, while maintaining Daikin’s premium market positioning. Key Responsibilities Drive sales of Daikin DX products (Split, SkyAir, Ducted, and Packaged units) through the assigned dealer network. Achieve assigned sales targets including bookings, revenue, margins, and collection goals. Identify, appoint, and develop new dealers to expand market coverage and strengthen channel presence. Build strong relationships with existing dealers to increase loyalty, engagement, and business volume. Support dealers with product selection, pricing, and technical guidance to close opportunities effectively. Conduct regular dealer visits, joint customer meetings, and market visits to generate demand and track pipeline. Ensure timely submission of quotations and follow-ups for order conversion. Monitor dealer performance and implement improvement plans to enhance productivity and sales efficiency. Train dealer sales teams on Daikin products, applications, and competitive positioning. Track market trends, competitor activities, and pricing strategies to maintain competitiveness. Coordinate with internal teams (Logistics, Finance, Service, and Marketing) to ensure smooth order execution and customer satisfaction. Ensure timely order processing, delivery coordination, and payment collection as per agreed terms. Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline data, and CRM updates. Support marketing initiatives, promotions, and dealer events to increase brand visibility. Ensure compliance with company policies, pricing guidelines, and channel management frameworks. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline). Minimum of 5 years of experience in HVAC sales, with a preference for experience in DX products and dealer/channel management. Strong understanding of DX systems, including splits, ducted, and packaged units. Experience working with dealer/distributor networks in the KSA market. Proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing channel partners. Required Skills Strong commercial acumen with experience in pricing and negotiations. Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills. Good technical aptitude with the ability to support dealers on product selection and applications. Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Self-driven, result-oriented, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Fluency in English is required; Arabic is an advantage. Work Environment This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and involves working within a dynamic sales environment focused on channel expansion and revenue growth. 0190e6f891881aba.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة مجالات الرياض للمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وإدارة أعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق، والإشراف على فرق العمل والمقاولين لضمان تنفيذ المهام بكفاءة ووفقًا للمعايير المطلوبة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة مجموعة من المهام الحيوية لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية، وتشمل: تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق المختلفة. إدارة المشاريع والإشراف على جميع أعضاء الفريق والأعمال ضمن نطاق الضيافة، النظافة، الصيانة، الزراعة، والمكافحة. متابعة والإشراف على أعمال المقاولين خلال تنفيذ المشاريع. تقديم الدراسات والتقارير اللازمة حول سير العمليات وحالة المرافق. المهام اليومية والإشراف يتضمن الدور الإشراف المباشر على الأنشطة اليومية وضمان الالتزام بالمعايير التشغيلية، ومن ذلك: مباشرة الإجراءات لضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، ومتابعة تنفيذها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية وتخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة، وتنسيق عمليات التصليح مع تقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح الخبرات والمؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة الأشغال والمرافق العامة. فهم عميق لقواعد الصحة والسلامة والبيئة ولوائحها. مهارات قوية في إدارة المشاريع والإشراف على فرق العمل. القدرة على إعداد الدراسات والتقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الفرصة الوظيفية بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة مجالات الرياض للمقاولات، حيث يساهم في الحفاظ على جودة وكفاءة المرافق المختلفة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المرشحين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الوظيفة في الرياض.

0141194b576dcc50.description: Role Overview The Treasury Manager is responsible for managing the company’s cash flow, liquidity, banking relationships, financing arrangements, guarantees, and overall treasury operations. The position ensures that sufficient funds are available to support ongoing construction projects and corporate operations while optimizing cash utilization, minimizing financial risks, and maintaining strong relationships with banks and financial institutions. Key Responsibilities 1. Treasury Management Manage the company’s daily treasury and cash management operations. Monitor cash positions, bank balances, inflows, and outflows. Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and long-term cash flow forecasts. Ensure adequate liquidity to meet project and corporate financial obligations. Optimize utilization of available cash and working capital. Monitor cash requirements for multiple construction projects. 2. Cash Flow Management Develop and maintain project-wise and company-wide cash flow forecasts. Monitor customer collections, project billing, subcontractor payments, payroll, suppliers, and other major cash movements. Identify potential cash shortages or surpluses and recommend appropriate actions. Coordinate closely with Finance, Accounts, Commercial, Procurement, and Project teams. Monitor working capital and improve cash conversion. 3. Banking & Financial Institutions Manage relationships with local and international banks. Negotiate banking facilities, credit lines, overdrafts, and other financial arrangements. Coordinate opening and maintenance of corporate and project bank accounts. Monitor bank charges, interest rates, commissions, and banking service agreements. Review and negotiate banking terms to achieve favorable commercial conditions. 4. Bank Guarantees & Letters of Credit Manage the complete lifecycle of Bank Guarantees (BGs), including: Performance Guarantees Advance Payment Guarantees Retention Guarantees Bid Bonds Other contractual guarantees Coordinate issuance, amendment, extension, reduction, and cancellation of guarantees. Monitor expiry dates and ensure timely renewal or release. Manage Letters of Credit (LCs) and other trade finance instruments where applicable. Maintain accurate records of all guarantees, LCs, and related bank facilities. 5. Construction Project Finance Monitor project-specific cash requirements and funding needs. Coordinate with Project Managers and Commercial teams regarding project billing and collections. Monitor advance payments, retention amounts, progress payments, and project receivables. Analyze project cash flow against approved budgets and forecasts. Support management in identifying project-level financial risks. 6. Accounts Receivable & Collections Monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables. Coordinate with Accounts Receivable and Commercial teams to improve collection performance. Track overdue invoices, retention receivables, and certified/unbilled amounts. Prepare collection forecasts and highlight potential cash flow risks to management. 7. Payments & Disbursements Review and monitor major supplier, subcontractor, payroll, tax, and project-related payments. Ensure payments are made in accordance with approved authorization procedures. Maintain appropriate payment controls and segregation of duties. Monitor payment schedules and prioritize payments according to cash availability and contractual obligations. 8. Foreign Exchange & Financial Risk Monitor foreign currency exposure arising from international suppliers, contractors, and project transactions. Assist management in managing foreign exchange and interest-rate risks. Monitor financial market conditions and recommend appropriate treasury strategies. Ensure compliance with approved treasury risk-management policies. 9. Financing & Working Capital Assist senior management in arranging project and corporate financing. Evaluate financing requirements and available banking facilities. Monitor loan balances, repayments, interest, and financing costs. Optimize working capital and financing structures. Prepare financial analysis for new financing requirements. 10. Treasury Reporting & Controls Prepare treasury reports, cash flow forecasts, liquidity reports, and banking reports for senior management. Maintain accurate treasury records and supporting documentation. Perform regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies. Establish and maintain effective treasury controls and procedures. Ensure compliance with company policies and applicable Saudi regulations. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 6 - 10 years of relevant experience in Treasury/Finance. Strong experience in cash flow management, banking facilities, guarantees, letters of credit, and working capital management. Proven experience managing relationships with major local and international banks. Strong knowledge of banking products, trade finance, and financial instruments. Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar. Advanced knowledge of MS Excel and financial modeling. Fluency in Arabic and Proficiency in English. Preferred Qualifications & Experience Professional certification such as CFA, CMA, ACCA, CPA, or CTP. Relevant experience within the Construction, Contracting, EPC, or Infrastructure sector.

01bacd41a24b8ce7.description: Role Summary The Quality Inspector – Safety is responsible for monitoring and ensuring that all construction activities adhere to approved quality standards, safety procedures, and inspection protocols. The role involves conducting daily site inspections, identifying non-compliances, supporting contractors in quality and safety implementation, and coordinating closely with the QC Manager and Resident Engineers. This position plays a vital role in maintaining the integrity, safety, and quality of project execution on site. Key Responsibilities Perform daily site surveillances to ensure ongoing works comply with approved ITPs, checklists, and project requirements. Identify deficiencies, safety issues, and non-compliance on site; report immediately to the QC Manager and initiate corrective actions before work is covered. Ensure proper closure of WIRs (Work Inspection Requests) and MIRs (Material Inspection Requests) after obtaining signatures and verifying all required documentation. Review and understand project specifications, drawings, PQP, ITPs, method statements, QC procedures, and other relevant quality documents. Witness testing and sampling of concrete, soil, steel, and other materials; complete all related forms as per approved procedures. Monitor and comment on contractor quality control and safety practices to ensure compliance. Conduct daily coordination meetings with the contractor’s QC representative to reinforce proper quality management procedures. Assist the Construction team in resolving quality‑related and safety‑related issues. Support the Quality Manager in preparing and conducting internal/external quality audits. Prepare and submit daily QC reports to the QC Manager no later than 9:00 AM the following day. Verify that all testing equipment and devices have valid calibration certificates. Review and maintain logs of WIRs, MIRs, MARs, and other QC documentation. Report any miscoordination between disciplines to the Resident Engineer (RE) and Quality Manager (QM). Qualifications & Requirements 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably in a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, Health & Safety, or a related field. Strong understanding of quality control, site safety practices, testing procedures, and applicable regulations. Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and inspection procedures. Excellent attention to detail and strong reporting/documentation skills. Effective communication and proactive problem-solving approach.
